name: # Model producer serialization parity: args is [aontu-src], expected is the
# exact bytes of the model.json both implementations must write.
# Keys sort in lexical UTF-8 byte order - including numeric-string keys ("10"
# before "9") and astral-plane keys; the TS producer imposes this during
# serialization (JS objects would otherwise iterate integer-like keys first).
array-of-objects
args:
["beta: { y: 2, x: 1 }
alpha: 1
rows: [ { id: 2, tag: "b<x" }, { id: 1, tag: "a&y" } ]
nums: [ 30, 10, 20 ]
"]
